description: Utility functions for number formatting, file handling, and image export in a frontend project.

methods.name: formatNumberNoMagnitude
methods.description: Formats a number or string with magnitude suffix (K, M, B, T).

methods.name: formatNumberMagnitude
methods.description: Formats a number with magnitude suffix based on its value and column context.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Adds commas to large numbers for readability.

methods.name: includesDateNames
methods.description: Checks if a column name includes date-related keywords.

methods.name: includesPriceNames
methods.description: Checks if a column name includes price-related keywords.

methods.name: loadingOverlay
methods.description: Displays or hides a loading overlay with an optional message.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Performs a shallow equality check on two arrays.

methods.name: fuzzyFilter
methods.description: Filters data using fuzzy matching with rankItem.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves a Blob to a file, using File System Access API if available, otherwise triggers download.

methods.name: downloadData
methods.description: Exports data as CSV and triggers download or save.

methods.name: downloadImage
methods.description: Exports a DOM element as PNG image and triggers download or save.

methods.name: non_blocking
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function with specified delay.
